title: haworthia coarctata subsp. adelaidensis
intro: Haworthia coarctata subsp. adelaidensis, commonly known as the "Cushion Aloe," is a rare succulent plant species that belongs to the Xanthorrhoeaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, and research has shown that it has potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Haworthia coarctata subsp. adelaidensis include aloin, aloe-emodin, and other compounds that have been identified as having antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
